Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

health — the condition of your body. Example: My health is good.
habit — something you do often. Example: Sleep is a good habit.
exercise — physical activity that keeps you fit. Example: I do exercise every day.
sleep — to rest with your eyes closed at night. Example: I sleep eight hours.
stress — worry and pressure. Example: I have got a lot of stress at work.
energy — the power to do things. Example: A healthy lifestyle gives me energy.
lifestyle — the way you live. Example: My lifestyle is busy.
wellness — the state of being healthy. Example: Wellness is not only about medicine.
tired — needing rest or sleep. Example: I feel tired.
balance — a good mixture of things. Example: Balance is important in a diet.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I usually sleep ...
• I sometimes feel stress.
• It is not a disease.
• A healthy lifestyle gives energy.
• Balance is important.

elements.content: Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
Tiredness is not a disease. It is a habit problem: I sleep badly, I don't do exercise and I have got stress. A healthy lifestyle gives me energy.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: You look tired. B: I sleep badly and I have got stress. A: Try exercise and sleep. B: Yes, balance is important.
Speaking: Pair and group tasks: Discuss daily habits that support health and energy.
